title: config/console-personas.yaml (drydocs.console-personas.v1)
description: Shape only (S6): the console's demo roster - the seats that may sign in to a demo, the role each maps to, and the claim-to-role mapping declared and deferred rather than absent (CFG14; gate console-auth-boundary sC P4). NOT an authorization source - the server re-resolves the real role from the bearer token on every request (ADR 0005 decision 3), so the role a browser holds drives nav rendering only. Semantics - a role must be on the roles list, a tower_key above the user tier contradicts itself, and the claim block's status must agree with its contents - live in drydocs_core/console_personas.py and tests/unit/test_console_personas.py.

updated.description: date or string (YAML parses bare dates)

roles.description: The closed set of tiers. A fourth tier is an edit here and in the guard, never a value that widens the set by arriving.

personas.description: One entry per seat, keyed by the id a sign-in names. An empty roster would make every sign-in fail and every guard over it vacuous.

tower_key.description: User tier only: scopes the area cascade's default. A steward or admin is not scoped to one tower, so the reader refuses it above that tier.

claims.description: The claim-to-role mapping. Declared and deferred, never absent. The status and the contents must agree; the reader refuses them when they do not, because a declaration whose halves disagree is asserting something nobody checked.

reason.description: Required when deferred, forty characters or more: a bare deferral is a fact with no owner, a reasoned one is a decision someone can re-read and reverse. Length is enforced by the reader, not here.

mapping.description: Directory group name to application role. Empty when deferred.
